architecture.heading: Architecture Overview
architecture.intro: Land replaces VS Code's Electron stack with a modern, high-performance architecture:
architecture.mountain: Rust/Tauri native backend — manages windows, filesystem, processes
architecture.cocoon: TypeScript extension host — runs VS Code extensions via Effect-TS
architecture.wind: TypeScript UI services — re-implementation of VS Code workbench
architecture.sky: Astro UI components — renders the editor interface
architecture.air: Rust background daemon — updates, downloads, crypto signing
architecture.echo: Rust task scheduler — high-performance work-stealing executor
